title: Chain helper: revoke the tenant's shared stock access value if one is active, so the next process starts without one
description: A chain runs the cleanup of every process only at its END, so a process that leaves an active shared value (the old-app group) would break the next process that starts from none. This helper is placed between them in the chain: the administrator revokes the value; 204 when one was active, 404 when there was none. It creates nothing and changes nothing else, so there is nothing to clean up.
